title: Options Collar Strategy Explained: Payoff Diagram and Ratios
text: So, a collar takes this kind of shape and it says, "I want to cap my downside." That's the starting point for a collar. I want to cap my downside. But, then we say, "That's expensive. I don't want to pay all of that out of pocket." So, then I'm going to sell a call to help finance that long put, and that gives you this yellow payoff diagram, where we have both capped upside and downside. One note about this is this is at a one-to-one ratio. This means for every one long put that you have, and that equals the number of long shares that you have. So, if you have 100 shares, you have one long put. This also means you have one short call. That's how you get this specific payoff diagram. You can tweak it a little bit by, for example, selling less calls.
